Bodega Route of Pisco in Region Arequipa
author: NA
content: The pisco is the national drink and its production takes place in different valleys along Peru's coast. There exist various varieties and their quality stands out whenever this beverage participates in contests. In Moquegua, land of Saint Teresa, there exists the route of pisco, and those who arrive at the department feel tempted to explore it and learn about how this exquisite beverage is produced. Attempts were made recently in Tacna to establish a route of pisco but did not succeed; however, plans have been set forth to reactivate it as another ingredient towards generating tourism toward this bordering area.

headline: Hector Mayhuire Rodriguez 18 Wineries Along the Path of Pisco in the Arequipa Region
author: There are eighteen wineries considered within the jurisdiction according to the launch done by the Regional Government of Arequipa which aims to attract tourists both nationally and internationally to taste good Arequipa pisco due to the vigor and strength of producers found in Caravelí, Majes, Condesuyo, Castilla, Arequipa, and Islay. Different valleys also include irrigation areas where excellent pisco can be found, available even in major commercial centers domestically and abroad. Arequipa’s pisco holds its rightful spot and undoubtedly, the presented path will allow visitors to get up close with the cellars producing this prized beverage for decades now.

headline: Miami Herald reports support for president fell six points between April and July. Popularity of Donald Trump falls to 36 percent, according to recent poll.
author: NA
content: Approval of President Donald Trump dropped six percentage points between April and July amid difficulties advancing legislative agendas, according to a survey published Sunday. Nearly six months after taking office, Trump faces declining popularity, rising from 42 percent approval in April to 36 percent in July, according to the Washington Post–ABC News survey among 1,001 adults. Similarly, levels of disapproval rose five points to 58 percent. Sixty-six percent said they don't trust or barely trust Trump's ability to negotiate with foreign leaders, especially Russian Vladimir Putin (also 66 percent). The survey was conducted June 10 through 13 and carries a margin of sampling error plus or minus three-and-a-half percentage points.

headline: A woman died and other three people were injured yesterday when men opened fire against opponents voting during symbolic referendum organized by opposition in western Caracas suburb of Catia to measure sentiment over constituent assembly called by Venezuelan President Nicolas Maduro, prosecutor announced.
